content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic:
XQL(MP-038 Entra Sign-in for the Canary from the Pink Access IP) AND XQL(MP-038 Passkey Registered from the Sign-in IP Within Ten Minutes) AND XQL(MP-038 SharePoint and OneDrive Download Burst from the Pink IP) on cortexsim_saas_raw for the same principal and the same source IP: an Entra sign-in that required MFA, then a passkey registered from that IP (a security-info registration whose resultReason names a passkey, read as the passkey query reads it), then a SharePoint and OneDrive download burst, the whole chain inside 3600 s by the records' own body times (createdDateTime, activityDateTime, CreationTime), never _time. Operator-installed correlation rule (CortexSim never writes it to the tenant). Alert name exactly as this rule's name; severity Medium (only Medium or higher opens or joins a case); Scheduled, every 10 minutes, query time frame 1 hour; no MITRE tag; proposed alert field mapping principal -> User Name (untested). It reads the collector records only, so it needs the HTTP log collector created with Vendor cortexsim and Product saas. UNTESTED: this XQL has not run in any tenant. Collector field names are taken from the idp_signin_emulator and m365_activity_emitter records on dev, not from a stored collector row: lab prerequisite L-1 (the cortexsim / saas HTTP collector) is not done, so no Pink record has been read back from a tenant. How the collector exposes the nested initiatedBy object (read with json_extract_scalar), the ISO-8601 body times (read with parse_timestamp) and the numeric and boolean keys is unconfirmed. Records are joined on one principal value, coalesced from userPrincipalName (sign-in), initiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName (passkey audit record) and UserId (downloads); no list-valued field is read. Scoped by cortexsim_canary and the planted canary principal; every eal step's target_user is that same principal, so the passkey audit record's targetResources[] names it too. There is no current_time in the rule: the time frame bounds it. XQL:
dataset = cortexsim_saas_raw
| filter cortexsim_canary = "cortexsim-mp-038-pink"
| alter audit_principal = json_extract_scalar(initiatedBy, "$.user.userPrincipalName"), audit_ip = json_extract_scalar(initiatedBy, "$.user.ipAddress")
| alter principal = coalesce(userPrincipalName, audit_principal, UserId), source_ip = coalesce(ipAddress, audit_ip, ClientIP)
| filter principal = "cortexsim-mp-038-pink@cortexsim-canary.invalid"
| alter stage = if(createdDateTime != null and authenticationRequirement = "multiFactorAuthentication", "signin", if(activityDisplayName = "User registered security info" and resultReason contains "passkey", "passkey", if(Workload in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive") and Operation in ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull"), "download", "other")))
| filter stage != "other"
| alter stage_at = parse_timestamp("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%E*S%Ez", coalesce(createdDateTime, activityDateTime, CreationTime))
| alter signin_at = if(stage = "signin", stage_at, null), passkey_at = if(stage = "passkey", stage_at, null), download_at = if(stage = "download", stage_at, null)
| comp min(signin_at) as first_signin_at, min(passkey_at) as first_passkey_at, min(download_at) as first_download_at, count_distinct(stage) as stages, count() as records by principal, source_ip
| filter stages = 3
| alter passkey_after_signin_seconds = timestamp_diff(first_passkey_at, first_signin_at, "SECOND"), download_after_passkey_seconds = timestamp_diff(first_download_at, first_passkey_at, "SECOND"), chain_seconds = timestamp_diff(first_download_at, first_signin_at, "SECOND")
| filter passkey_after_signin_seconds >= 0 and download_after_passkey_seconds >= 0 and chain_seconds <= 3600
rules.name: Pink — Sign-in, Passkey and Download Burst on One Principal

rules.logic:
XQL(MP-038 SharePoint and OneDrive Download Burst from the Pink IP) AND (XQL(MP-038 Internal Fan-out Send from the Extortion IP) OR XQL(MP-038 Teams Messages by the Canary from the Extortion IP)) on cortexsim_saas_raw for the same principal: the first SharePoint or OneDrive download, then the first Exchange Send or Teams MessageSent, inside 3600 s by CreationTime, never _time. The first download, not the last: with two runs in one window the last download can postdate the first extortion message and the gap goes negative. The source IPs differ on purpose (the access IP downloads, the residential proxy sends). Operator-installed correlation rule (CortexSim never writes it to the tenant). Alert name exactly as this rule's name; severity Medium; Scheduled, every 10 minutes, query time frame 1 hour; no MITRE tag; proposed alert field mapping UserId -> User Name (untested). It needs the HTTP log collector created with Vendor cortexsim and Product saas. UNTESTED: this XQL has not run in any tenant. Collector field names are taken from the idp_signin_emulator and m365_activity_emitter records on dev, not from a stored collector row: lab prerequisite L-1 (the cortexsim / saas HTTP collector) is not done, so no Pink record has been read back from a tenant. How the collector exposes the nested initiatedBy object (read with json_extract_scalar), the ISO-8601 body times (read with parse_timestamp) and the numeric and boolean keys is unconfirmed. Records are joined on UserId only; MailboxOwnerUPN, recipientList and Teams Members are not read (MailboxOwnerUPN and Members name the same principal, since every eal step's target_user is the canary principal; Members and recipientList are lists). No current_time in the rule. XQL:
dataset = cortexsim_saas_raw
| filter cortexsim_canary = "cortexsim-mp-038-pink"
| filter UserId = "cortexsim-mp-038-pink@cortexsim-canary.invalid"
| alter stage = if(Workload in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive") and Operation in ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull"), "download", if(Workload = "Exchange" and Operation = "Send", "extortion_mail", if(Workload = "MicrosoftTeams" and Operation = "MessageSent", "extortion_teams", "other")))
| filter stage != "other"
| alter stage_at = parse_timestamp("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%E*S%Ez", CreationTime)
| alter download_at = if(stage = "download", stage_at, null), extortion_at = if(stage in ("extortion_mail", "extortion_teams"), stage_at, null)
| comp min(download_at) as first_download_at, min(extortion_at) as first_extortion_at, count_distinct(stage) as stages, count_distinct(ClientIP) as source_ips by UserId
| filter first_download_at != null and first_extortion_at != null
| alter extortion_after_download_seconds = timestamp_diff(first_extortion_at, first_download_at, "SECOND")
| filter extortion_after_download_seconds >= 0 and extortion_after_download_seconds <= 3600
rules.name: Pink — Download Burst then Internal Extortion on One Principal
